accepted.requirement: Continue parsing a number across multiple calls on one tokener so saved exponent state is reconstructed.
accepted.target_route: Supply chunks "[0", "e+", then "-]" to successive json_tokener_parse_ex calls on one tokener.
accepted.failure_condition: The entry calls json_tokener_parse_ex only once, then frees the tokener, so no input can reach the saved-state branch.
accepted.alternative_paths: A one-call input may produce the same final error, but cannot exercise continuation of the same tokener state; the complete entry contains no second parse call.

accepted.requirement: Exercise the parser's supported strict-mode rejection of an incomplete exponent.
accepted.target_route: Set JSON_TOKENER_STRICT on a tokener and parse "[0e]".
accepted.failure_condition: The entry never sets flags; the calloc-initialized flags remain zero, selecting permissive trimming instead of strict rejection.
accepted.alternative_paths: Other input bytes cannot set tokener flags, and the complete entry has no configuration or equivalent strict-mode call route.
